records.title: Under One Aurora
records.selection: Featured artist, recommended by the Fairbanks Region III supervisor

story.en: Alaska's 2026 I Voted stickers carry art by Anchorage artist Amanda Rose Warren, the Division of Elections' featured artist this year. Her "Under One Aurora" designs show five animals for the state's five regions (a humpback whale, moose, fox, musk ox and bear) under the same aurora, with the American and Alaska flags.
story.es: Los stickers de I Voted de Alaska para 2026 llevan arte de Amanda Rose Warren, artista de Anchorage y la artista invitada de la División de Elecciones este año. Sus diseños "Under One Aurora" muestran cinco animales por las cinco regiones del estado (una ballena jorobada, un alce, un zorro, un buey almizclero y un oso) bajo la misma aurora, con las banderas de Estados Unidos y de Alaska.
story.quote: Additionally, her artwork will be featured on the Division of Elections' "I Voted" stickers for the 2026 election.

story.en: For the November 3, 2026 general election, Alabama's Secretary of State released newly designed America 250 I Voted stickers, marking the country's 250th anniversary.
story.es: Para la elección general del 3 de noviembre de 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de Alabama sacó stickers de I Voted con un diseño nuevo de America 250, por los 250 años del país.
story.quote: Wes Allen, Alabama's Secretary of State is announcing the release of newly designed America 250 "I Voted" stickers

records.title: Six student-designed I Voted stickers
records.office: Santa Clara County Registrar of Voters
records.selection: Student contest, public vote

story.en: Santa Clara County's first I Voted sticker contest drew 203 student designs, and more than 10,000 public votes picked six winners. More than one million vote-by-mail packets for November 3 include one of the six, and all six are handed out at the county's Vote Centers.
story.es: El primer concurso de stickers I Voted del condado de Santa Clara recibió 203 diseños de estudiantes, y más de 10,000 votos del público eligieron seis ganadores. Más de un millón de paquetes de voto por correo para el 3 de noviembre traen uno de los seis, y los seis se reparten en los centros de votación (Vote Centers) del condado.
story.quote: Beginning in October, more than one million registered voters will receive one of the six winning stickers in their Vote by Mail packets for the November 3rd General Election.

story.en: Colorado has an "I Voted" digital sticker contest for high school students. The Secretary of State's staff pick the winner by popular vote, and the winning design shows up in BallotTrax messages and a statewide press release.
story.es: Colorado tiene un concurso de stickers digitales de "I Voted" para estudiantes de preparatoria. El personal de la Secretaría de Estado elige al ganador por voto popular, y el diseño ganador aparece en los mensajes de BallotTrax y en un comunicado de prensa estatal.
story.quote: The creator of the winning design will be featured in a statewide press release, media coverage, and BallotTrax messages.

records.title: I Voted Today
records.office: Connecticut registrars of voters (state law, chapter 146)

story.en: Connecticut law makes room for the I voted sticker: poll workers can hand out "I Voted Today" stickers right inside the 75-foot no-campaigning zone.
story.es: La ley de Connecticut le hace espacio al sticker de "I voted": los trabajadores electorales pueden repartir stickers de "I Voted Today" dentro de la zona de 75 pies donde no se permite hacer campaña.
story.quote: (2) the registrars of voters from directing the officials at a primary, referendum or election to distribute, within the restricted area, adhesive labels on which are imprinted the words “I Voted Today”

records.title: Pink flamingo
records.selection: A seventh grader's design, from more than 175 student entries

story.en: Some Florida counties pick their stickers in student contests. In Sarasota County, a seventh grader's pink flamingo, chosen from more than 175 student entries, is the sticker for November 3, offered to everyone who votes by mail, early or on Election Day.
story.es: Algunos condados de Florida eligen sus stickers en concursos para estudiantes. En el condado de Sarasota, un flamenco rosa dibujado por un estudiante de séptimo grado, elegido entre más de 175 propuestas, es el sticker del 3 de noviembre, y se le ofrece a todo el que vote por correo, por anticipado o el Día de las Elecciones.
story.quote: This year, a pink flamingo is at the center of the sticker, and I think the voters are going to love this design as much as they did the previous one.

records.selection: County design contest

distribution.en: Each county picks its own sticker. In Clay County, the winning design from the county's contest is handed out during early voting and on Election Day in 2026.
distribution.quote: One original sticker design will be chosen and reproduced for distribution during Early Voting and Election Day for both the Primary and General Elections in 2026.

story.en: Georgia has a new statewide I voted sticker for 2026, designed by Georgia artist Steve Penley. Five million were printed and sent to all 159 counties, so you can pick one up when you vote.
story.es: Georgia tiene un nuevo sticker estatal de "I voted" para 2026, diseñado por el artista de Georgia Steve Penley. Se imprimieron cinco millones y se mandaron a los 159 condados, así que puedes llevarte uno cuando votes.
story.quote: Five million stickers featuring the unique design have been printed and will be distributed to all 159 counties across Georgia.

distribution.en: Yes. The Secretary of State sent the 2026 sticker to all 159 counties, and voters could get it from the first day of early voting, October 13.
distribution.quote: Voters can get the stickers when early voting starts on October 13.

records.title: Virtual I Voted sticker
records.selection: Download after your ballot is accepted for counting

story.en: Hawaii tied its sticker to ballot tracking: in 2022, once your ballot was accepted for counting, you could download a virtual I Voted sticker.
story.es: Hawaii unió su sticker al seguimiento de boletas: en 2022, una vez que aceptaban tu boleta para contarla, podías descargar un sticker virtual de I Voted.
story.quote: “Once your ballot has been accepted for counting, voters can also download their virtual ‘I Voted’ sticker,” he added.

records.title: County contest stickers; I Voted After Dark for evening early voters
records.selection: County design contest

story.en: In Johnson County, people who vote early after 5 p.m. during the Auditor's Voting After Dark evening hours get a special I Voted After Dark sticker. The evening hours run at the Auditor's Office and the Iowa City Public Library through October 28.
story.es: En el condado de Johnson, quienes votan por anticipado después de las 5 p. m., durante el horario nocturno Voting After Dark de la oficina del Auditor, reciben un sticker especial I Voted After Dark. El horario nocturno es en la oficina del Auditor y en la Biblioteca Pública de Iowa City hasta el 28 de octubre.
story.quote: Special "I Voted After Dark" stickers will be available only after 5:00 PM.

distribution.en: In Johnson County, yes. The county's 2026 "I Voted" stickers, chosen in its design contest, are handed out during early voting and on Election Day.
distribution.quote: The winning designs will become the official stickers distributed during early voting and on Election Day in 2026 and 2027.

story.en: Idaho's own voting guide ends with a sticker: after you turn in your ballot, grab an I Voted sticker and wear it proudly.
story.es: La propia guía para votar de Idaho termina con un sticker: después de entregar tu boleta, toma un sticker de I Voted y llévalo con orgullo.
story.quote: Grab an “I Voted” sticker and wear it proudly!

distribution.en: Each county picks its own sticker. In Champaign County, the clerk's early voting steps end with taking an "I Voted" sticker once your ballot is cast.
distribution.quote: Take an "I Voted" sticker and you're done!

story.en: The Secretary of State's own list of what to expect when you vote ends with leaving the polling place, and a reminder not to forget your sticker.
story.es: La propia lista de la Secretaría de Estado sobre qué esperar cuando votas termina con salir del lugar de votación, y un recordatorio de no olvidar tu sticker.
story.quote: Exit the polling place (don’t forget your sticker)

records.title: 2026 voting sticker contest winners
records.selection: County contest

distribution.en: In Sedgwick County, yes. The county election office says voters can wear the 2026 stickers they get at the polls or in an advance by mail ballot, so check your envelope.
distribution.quote: wear stickers they get at the polls or in an advance by mail ballot

records.title: 2026 I voted sticker contest
records.selection: Third annual contest for K-12 students

story.en: For 2026, the Secretary of State's third annual I voted sticker contest is open to Kentucky students in kindergarten through 12th grade. The winning design will be handed to voters in participating counties during the 2026 general election.
story.es: Para 2026, el tercer concurso anual de stickers de "I voted" de la Secretaría de Estado está abierto a estudiantes de Kentucky desde kínder hasta 12.º grado. El diseño ganador se va a entregar a los votantes de los condados participantes durante la elección general de 2026.
story.quote: The winning sticker design will be handed to voters in participating counties during the 2026 general election.

records.title: 2026 I voted sticker, artist series
records.selection: Artist series (sixth sticker since 2016)

story.en: Louisiana's 2026 I voted sticker was painted by New Orleans artist Terrance Osborne. It's the state's sixth artist-designed sticker, a series that started in 2016 with George Rodrigue's Blue Dog.
story.es: El sticker de "I voted" de Louisiana para 2026 lo pintó el artista de New Orleans Terrance Osborne. Es el sexto sticker del estado diseñado por artistas, una serie que empezó en 2016 con el Blue Dog de George Rodrigue.
story.quote: The artwork for this year’s sticker was created by New Orleans artist Terrance Osborne, who also attended the unveiling.

records.title: Four young artists' 2026 I Voted designs
records.selection: Youth contest, chosen by the Board of Registrars

story.en: In Middleborough, four young artists, Nolan, Abby, Calleigh and Colette, won the Town Clerk's 2026 I Voted sticker contest. The Board of Registrars picked their designs, and voters get them in November.
story.es: En Middleborough, cuatro artistas jóvenes, Nolan, Abby, Calleigh y Colette, ganaron el concurso de stickers I Voted 2026 de la oficina del secretario municipal (Town Clerk). La junta de registradores eligió sus diseños, y los votantes los reciben en noviembre.
story.quote: After carefully reviewing all entries, the Board of Registrars selected the winning designs that will be proudly distributed to voters during the November election.

records.title: Printable I Voted sticker for early and mail voters

distribution.en: In Somerville, the city's Elections Division posts an "I Voted" sticker image for early and mail voters to print at home or share online.
distribution.quote: Early and mail-in voters can have stickers too

records.title: Downloadable I Voted stickers, two in English and Spanish

story.en: The State Board of Elections has I voted sticker designs you can download, including two that say it in English and Spanish. One puts an oriole, a crab, a racehorse and a black-eyed Susan on the state flag. Another shows the Bay Bridge with a heron underneath.
story.es: La Junta Electoral del Estado tiene diseños de stickers de "I voted" que puedes descargar, incluidos dos que lo dicen en inglés y en español. Uno pone una oropéndola (oriole), un cangrejo, un caballo de carreras y una flor black-eyed Susan sobre la bandera del estado. Otro muestra el puente de la bahía (Bay Bridge) con una garza abajo.
story.quote: Click to download the I VOTED sticker you like!

records.title: 2026 I Voted sticker contest winners
records.selection: Statewide contest; public vote on finalists; nine winners in three categories

story.en: Michigan has a statewide I Voted sticker contest, started in 2024 by the Secretary of State's college student advisory task force. This year more than 2,000 designs came in, the public voted on finalists, and nine winners were picked in three categories. Local clerks can order the winning stickers for November.
story.es: Michigan tiene un concurso estatal de stickers de I Voted, que empezó en 2024 por idea del grupo asesor de estudiantes universitarios de la Secretaría de Estado. Este año llegaron más de 2,000 diseños, el público votó por los finalistas y se eligieron nueve ganadores en tres categorías. Los secretarios locales pueden pedir los stickers ganadores para noviembre.
story.quote: Winning stickers will be available for election clerks to order for the November election.

distribution.en: Look in your ballot envelope. In the City of Northville, every absentee ballot comes with voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker. Other clerks decide for themselves.
distribution.quote: Your ballot comes with complete voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker.

story.en: Minnesota's I voted sticker is written into state law: it says "I VOTED," and nothing more. Election officials can give one to you when you put your ballot in the ballot box, and to people who vote by mail too.
story.es: El sticker de "I voted" de Minnesota está escrito en la ley estatal: dice "I VOTED", y nada más. Las autoridades electorales te pueden dar uno cuando metes tu boleta en la urna, y también a quienes votan por correo.
story.quote: The secretary of state, county auditor, municipal clerk, school district clerk, or an election judge may provide a sticker containing the words "I VOTED," and nothing more, to an individual who:

records.title: Three new I Voted designs
records.selection: Student contest, grades 6 to 12, 151 entries, one winner per category

story.en: In Lincoln County, students design the stickers. The county clerk's contest drew 151 entries from students in grades 6 to 12, for three new I voted designs for the county's 2026 and 2027 elections.
story.es: En el condado de Lincoln, los estudiantes diseñan los stickers. El concurso de la oficina del condado recibió 151 propuestas de estudiantes de 6.º a 12.º grado, para tres nuevos diseños de "I voted" para las elecciones del condado de 2026 y 2027.
story.quote: There will be a winner from each category resulting in 3 new "I Voted" sticker designs for the 2026/2027 Lincoln County elections.

records.office: St. Louis Board of Election Commissioners

distribution.en: In the City of St. Louis, every in-person voter can pick up an "I Voted" sticker on the way out, absentee voters included. Other election authorities set their own practice.
distribution.quote: No matter what method you use to vote, you can pick up an "I Voted" sticker on your way out.

records.title: 2026 I Voted sticker contest
records.selection: Contest open to registered voters 18 and older; for all 82 counties

story.en: For 2026, the Secretary of State ran a contest for Mississippi voters to design the I voted sticker for all 82 counties.
story.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado organizó un concurso para que los votantes de Mississippi diseñaran el sticker de "I voted" para los 82 condados.
story.quote: Anyone 18 years and older who is registered to vote in Mississippi is encouraged to design and submit artwork to be used as the "I Voted" sticker for all 82 counties during the 2026 election cycle .

records.title: 2026 I Voted sticker
records.office: Montana Secretary of State, with election officials from all 56 counties

story.en: Montana has a new I Voted sticker for 2026, made by the Secretary of State with election officials from all 56 counties. It's red, white and blue, with an outline of the state and its mountains. You'll get one at polling places and county election offices.
story.es: Montana tiene un nuevo sticker de "I Voted" para 2026, hecho por la Secretaría de Estado con funcionarios electorales de los 56 condados. Es rojo, blanco y azul, con la silueta del estado y sus montañas. Te lo dan en los lugares de votación y en las oficinas electorales de los condados.
story.quote: Montanans will see the new sticker at polling places and in county election offices during the 2026 Primary and General Elections.

records.selection: Public vote, then the Board picks from the top three

story.en: Some North Carolina counties let residents help pick the sticker. Durham County's 2026 contest opened with public voting, and the top three designs go to the county Board of Elections, which picks the winner.
story.es: Algunos condados de North Carolina dejan que los residentes ayuden a elegir el sticker. El concurso de 2026 del condado de Durham empezó con una votación pública, y los tres diseños con más votos pasan a la junta electoral del condado (Board of Elections), que elige al ganador.
story.quote: Following that round, the top three designs will be presented to the Durham County Board of Elections for selection of the winning design.

distribution.en: In Guilford County, early voting officials hand you an "I Voted Early" sticker once your ballot has gone through the tabulator, and curbside voters get one at the car. Other counties choose their own stickers.
distribution.quote: Stickers should be handed out after the ballot has been successfully tabulated.

records.title: You Betcha I Voted
records.selection: First statewide contest; 478 entries; public vote

story.en: North Dakota held its first statewide I Voted sticker contest for 2026. Haylee Senger of Bottineau won with "You Betcha I Voted," picked by 4,792 North Dakotans from 478 artists' entries. It debuted at the June 9 primary.
story.es: North Dakota hizo su primer concurso estatal de stickers de "I Voted" para 2026. Ganó Haylee Senger, de Bottineau, con "You Betcha I Voted", elegido por 4,792 personas de North Dakota entre las propuestas de 478 artistas. Se estrenó en la elección primaria del 9 de junio.
story.quote: Haylee Senger from Bottineau submitted the winning “You Betcha I Voted” sticker design, which debuted at the polls during the 2026 Primary Election on June 9.

records.title: Fourth and fifth grade I Voted sticker contest
records.selection: Student contest (grades 4 and 5); finalists chosen by the Secretary of State's office, winners by a panel of local election officials

story.en: New Hampshire's Secretary of State ran an I Voted sticker contest for fourth and fifth graders, with the theme "Celebrating 250 Years of New Hampshire History!" A panel of local election officials picks the winning designs, which are handed out as stickers to voters in the 2026 state elections.
story.es: La Secretaría de Estado de New Hampshire hizo un concurso de stickers de I Voted para estudiantes de cuarto y quinto grado, con el tema "Celebrating 250 Years of New Hampshire History!" Un panel de funcionarios electorales locales elige los diseños ganadores, que se reparten como stickers a los votantes en las elecciones estatales de 2026.
story.quote: A panel of local election officials will choose four winning designs, which will be distributed as stickers to all voters during the 2026 state elections.

records.title: Three winning designs
records.selection: Student contest, closed September 8

story.en: In Santa Fe County, students design the I Voted sticker. The county clerk's 2026 contest closed September 8, and the three winning designs are being printed for voters this election.
story.es: En el condado de Santa Fe, los estudiantes diseñan el sticker de "I Voted". El concurso 2026 de la secretaría del condado cerró el 8 de septiembre, y los tres diseños ganadores se imprimen para los votantes en esta elección.
story.quote: The winning 3 designs will be printed and shared with voters during this election cycle.

records.title: I Voted Early, I Voted and Future Voter
records.selection: Student contest

distribution.en: In Los Alamos County, yes. The county's 2026 student contest has an "I Voted Early" design along with "I Voted" and "Future Voter," and the winners go to every county voting location this year.
distribution.quote: will be printed and distributed as official stickers at all Los Alamos County voting locations for the 2026 elections

distribution.en: In Clark County, the 2026 voter guide's in-person steps, for early voting October 17 to 30 and on Election Day, end with getting your "I Voted" sticker at the tabulator. Other counties set their own practice.
distribution.quote: Receive your “I Voted” sticker.

records.selection: Student contest, ages 9 to 18, sixth year; public vote on finalists

story.en: Ulster County's Board of Elections runs a student I Voted sticker contest, now in its sixth year. Students ages 9 to 18 send in designs, the public votes on the finalists, and the winning sticker goes to every voter in the county on November 3, 2026.
story.es: La Junta Electoral del condado de Ulster organiza un concurso de stickers de I Voted para estudiantes, que ya va en su sexto año. Estudiantes de 9 a 18 años mandan sus diseños, el público vota por los finalistas, y el sticker ganador se le da a cada votante del condado el 3 de noviembre de 2026.
story.quote: The design with the most votes will be produced and distributed to all voters at the November 3, 2026 General Election.

distribution.en: In New York City, the city's 2026 general election guide tells voters at early voting and Election Day poll sites to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before they leave. Other counties set their own practice.
distribution.quote: Don't forget to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before you leave!

records.title: 2019 student I Voted sticker
records.selection: Contest for grades 6 to 12; three finalists; public vote

story.en: In 2019 the Secretary of State ran a contest for students in grades 6 to 12 to design Ohio's I Voted sticker. Over 2,000 entries came in, and more than 15,000 votes picked the winner: Emily Legg, a 12th grader at Teays Valley High School in Pickaway County.
story.es: En 2019 la Secretaría de Estado organizó un concurso para que estudiantes de 6.º a 12.º grado diseñaran el sticker de I Voted de Ohio. Llegaron más de 2,000 diseños, y más de 15,000 votos eligieron a la ganadora: Emily Legg, de 12.º grado en Teays Valley High School, en el condado de Pickaway.
story.quote: Secretary LaRose selected the three finalists and more than 15,000 votes were cast for the winner -- Emily Legg, a 12th grader from Teays Valley High School in Pickaway County.

distribution.en: Yes, while supplies last. The Secretary of State sent every county board of elections a limited supply of America 250 "I Voted" stickers for voters who vote in person, early or on Election Day.
distribution.quote: Voters who cast a ballot in person during early voting or on Election Day will receive the commemorative sticker while supplies last.

story.en: Ask for your I Voted sticker before you leave the election enclosure. The State Election Board's tip: wear it to encourage others to vote.
story.es: Pide tu sticker de I Voted antes de salir del área electoral (election enclosure). El consejo de la Junta Electoral del Estado: llévalo puesto para animar a otros a votar.
story.quote: Be sure to get an "I Voted" sticker before you leave the election enclosure and wear it to encourage others to get out and vote!

story.en: Oregon votes by mail, so the Secretary of State offers virtual I Voted stickers to share instead, with lines like "I Voted (By Mail)" and "I Voted (The Oregon Way)".
story.es: Oregon vota por correo, así que la Secretaría de Estado ofrece stickers virtuales de I Voted para compartir, con frases como "I Voted (By Mail)" y "I Voted (The Oregon Way)".
story.quote: I Voted (virtual sticker)

records.title: Virtual I Voted sticker with BallotTrax tracking

distribution.en: In Multnomah County, sign up for ballot tracking at BallotTrax and you get a virtual "I Voted" sticker to share once your ballot is in. Other counties decide for themselves.
distribution.quote: You'll even receive a virtual "I Voted" sticker that's ready to share on social media.

records.title: I Voted N'at
records.selection: Student contest, public vote

story.en: Allegheny County's first I Voted sticker contest drew more than 13,000 public votes. The winner, I Voted N'at, by Molly, a 10th grader at Mt. Lebanon High School, is the county's sticker for the 2025 and 2026 elections.
story.es: El primer concurso de stickers I Voted del condado de Allegheny recibió más de 13,000 votos del público. El diseño ganador, I Voted N'at, de Molly, estudiante de 10.º grado de Mt. Lebanon High School, es el sticker del condado para las elecciones de 2025 y 2026.
story.quote: I Voted N'at design of "balancing civic duty and Pittsburgh pride" was printed for the 2025 and 2026 elections cycles in Allegheny County.

story.en: After you put your ballot in the voting machine, wear your I Voted sticker. The Department of State's 2026 voter handbook says so.
story.es: Después de meter tu boleta en la máquina de votación, ponte tu sticker de I Voted. Lo dice el manual del votante 2026 del Departamento de Estado.
story.quote: Wear your “I VOTED” sticker!

distribution.en: Yes. The Department of State's early voting steps end with returning the empty secrecy folder and wearing your "I voted" sticker.
distribution.quote: proudly wear your “I voted” sticker!

distribution.en: Look in your mail ballot packet. The Department of State lists an "I Voted by Mail" sticker among the items it includes.
distribution.quote: I Voted by Mail sticker

records.office: Charleston County Board of Voter Registration and Elections
records.selection: Student contest

distribution.en: Each county picks its own sticker. In Charleston County, the 2026 student contest winners go to early voters at every early voting center, and to absentee voters, for a limited time.
distribution.quote: Winning designs will be distributed for a limited time at all early voting centers and to our absentee voters this fall.

records.title: Civics in the 605 Statewide Sticker Showcase
records.selection: Student contest, kindergarten through 12th grade, four age groups

story.en: For the 2026 general election, the Secretary of State asked South Dakota students to design the next I Voted sticker, through the Civics in the 605 Statewide Sticker Showcase. Entries came in from kindergarten through 12th grade, in four age groups.
story.es: Para la elección general de 2026, la Secretaría de Estado invitó a estudiantes de South Dakota a diseñar el próximo sticker de "I Voted", con el concurso estatal Civics in the 605 Statewide Sticker Showcase. Participaron desde kínder hasta 12.º grado, en cuatro grupos de edad.
story.quote: The Secretary of State's Office invited students to design the next “I Voted” sticker for use during the 2026 General Election.

story.en: Tennessee's 2026 I Voted sticker is a special America 250 edition from the Secretary of State, with patriotic artwork for the country's 250th anniversary. It's handed out at polling places during this year's elections.
story.es: El sticker de I Voted de Tennessee para 2026 es una edición especial de America 250 de la Secretaría de Estado, con arte patriótico por los 250 años del país. Se reparte en los lugares de votación durante las elecciones de este año.
story.quote: The special America 250 sticker, which will be available at polling locations during upcoming elections, features patriotic artwork recognizing the nation's semiquincentennial and serves as a reminder of the enduring importance of civic engagement.

records.title: I Voted and Future Voter student designs
records.selection: Student contest (2025), first place in each category

story.en: El Paso County's sticker contest drew 162 student designs. The first-place winners, an I Voted sticker by Novalie, a 10th grader at Eastwood High School, and a Future Voter sticker by Sophia, a 4th grader at Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, go to voters during the 2026 elections.
story.es: El concurso de stickers del condado de El Paso recibió 162 diseños de estudiantes. Los primeros lugares, un sticker I Voted de Novalie, estudiante de 10.º grado de Eastwood High School, y un sticker Future Voter de Sophia, estudiante de 4.º grado de Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, se reparten a los votantes durante las elecciones de 2026.
story.quote: First-place winning designs will be distributed to voters during the 2026 election season.

records.selection: A student's design

distribution.en: Each Texas county picks its own sticker. In Gaines County, the 2026 sticker is a student's design, handed out at every early voting location and Election Day vote center.
distribution.quote: The sticker will be distributed to voters at all Early Voting Locations and Election Day Vote Centers during the 2026 elections.

story.en: In 2020, vote.utah.gov posted four I Voted stickers you could download and print at home.
story.es: En 2020, vote.utah.gov publicó cuatro stickers de "Ya voté" (I Voted) para descargar e imprimir en casa.
story.quote: Click here to download all four 2020 “I Voted” stickers

distribution.en: Each locality picks its own sticker. In the City of Roanoke, limited America 250 "I Voted" stickers are handed out during early voting and at each precinct on Election Day.
distribution.quote: Limited quantities of America 250 "I Voted" stickers will be distributed during early voting and at each precinct on Election Day.

records.title: Student alternative I Voted sticker
records.office: Vermont Secretary of State (supports the contest)
records.selection: Yearly K-8 student contest; designs go to the winner's home district

story.en: Each year the Secretary of State's office supports a contest where K-8 students design an alternative "I Voted" sticker, and the winning designs go to voters in the student's home district. This year's winners are from Burlington, so Burlington voters get them on Election Day.
story.es: Cada año, la Secretaría de Estado apoya un concurso en el que estudiantes de kínder a 8.º grado diseñan un sticker alternativo de "I Voted", y los diseños ganadores se entregan a los votantes del distrito del estudiante. Este año los ganadores son de Burlington, así que quienes votan en Burlington los reciben el Día de las Elecciones.
story.quote: The winning designs are distributed in the student’s home district.

records.title: Seven new I Voted designs, one made with the Tulalip Tribes

story.en: Snohomish County has seven new I Voted designs for the November 3 election, showing the county's landscapes, industries and cultures. One was made with the Tulalip Tribes and reflects Coast Salish heritage. Once you've returned your ballot, you can get one at the Auditor's Office in Everett, any Sno-Isle Libraries location or an accessible voter services site, during their open hours.
story.es: El condado de Snohomish tiene siete diseños nuevos de sticker de "I Voted" para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, con paisajes, industrias y culturas del condado. Uno se hizo junto con las Tribus Tulalip (Tulalip Tribes) y refleja la herencia cultural Coast Salish. Cuando ya hayas entregado tu boleta, puedes conseguir uno en la oficina del auditor en Everett (Auditor's Office), en cualquier biblioteca de Sno-Isle Libraries o en un centro accesible de servicios para votantes, en su horario de atención.
story.quote: one of Snohomish County’s new “I Voted” stickers, available at the Auditor’s Office in Everett, all Sno-Isle Libraries locations

distribution.en: Check your ballot packet first, since some counties put a sticker in it. Thurston County includes its "I Voted" sticker, by local artist Alexis Trono, in every ballot packet through the 2027 primary, this election included.
distribution.quote: be included in every ballot packet through the 2027 Primary Election, including the 2026 federal midterms

records.title: First statewide I Voted! sticker
records.selection: First statewide contest for eighth graders

story.en: West Virginia held its first statewide I Voted! sticker contest for eighth graders in 2026. Reese Childers of Shady Spring Middle School in Raleigh County won, and Raleigh County handed 11,000 of her stickers to in-person voters in the May primary.
story.es: West Virginia hizo en 2026 su primer concurso estatal de stickers de "¡Ya voté!" (I Voted!) para estudiantes de octavo grado. Ganó Reese Childers, de la secundaria Shady Spring del condado de Raleigh, y el condado de Raleigh repartió 11,000 de sus stickers a quienes votaron en persona en las primarias de mayo.
story.quote: In addition, Raleigh County Clerk Scott Van Meter was presented with 11,000 stickers featuring Reese's design to be handed out to Raleigh County voters who vote in-person in the Primary Election.

records.title: 150th anniversary of women's suffrage I Voted sticker
records.selection: Contest for high school juniors and seniors and college students; county clerks to hand out the winners

story.en: In 2019, for the 150th anniversary of women's suffrage in Wyoming, the Secretary of State's office ran an I Voted sticker design contest for high school juniors and seniors and college students. County clerks were to hand out the winning stickers at polling places.
story.es: En 2019, por el 150 aniversario del voto de las mujeres en Wyoming, la Secretaría de Estado organizó un concurso de diseño de stickers de "Ya voté" (I Voted) para estudiantes de los dos últimos años de preparatoria y de universidad. Los secretarios de condado iban a repartir los stickers ganadores en los lugares de votación.
story.quote: The Wyoming County Clerks will be distributing the stickers at polling places during Early Voting and on Election Day.
